FK Jaunība was a Latvian football club located in Riga. The club last played in 2. līga – the third tier of Latvian football. Previously they played in Virsliga, but after finishing the 2018–19 season in 7th place in the 2.liga and playing their last recorded match against SK Super Nova–2 on the 25th of September 2019, they were never heard from again.
